responsibility: Header for the Objective-C++ declaration remapping helpers, exporting wrappers that replace selected C++ front-end entry points with ObjC++-aware versions and defining the macro overrides needed to reinterpret type names, ObjC language-specific type data, and function/compound-statement handling when ObjC++ reuses C++ parser code.
same_name_distinction: Interface header for the ObjC++ declaration remapping layer: it declares the objcp_* wrapper entry points and, when OBJCP_REMAP_FUNCTIONS is enabled, redirects C++ parser/front-end names such as start_struct, finish_function, xref_tag, and compound-statement hooks to those wrappers via macros. Unlike the .cc twin, it provides compile-time name substitution and type-data macro overrides rather than implementations.
